Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5360622. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls. Return molecule_chembl_id, pref_name as molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
